|game_text=If a Geonosis location on table, deploy on table. Once per battle, may deploy or move a clone as a ‘react’ to same location as your Jedi or Padawan. While your clone in battle with a Jedi or Padawan, opponent’s total battle destiny is -1 (-2 if Yoda in battle). [Immune to Alter.]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Battle Of Geonosis]] (its only version). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. It is the current text.
